paragraphs.text: Because he would inform Esther of this cruel proclamation.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: Thus Mordecai spoke in the confidence of that faith which all God's children should have; which is that God will deliver them, though all worldly means fail.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: To deliver God's Church out of these present dangers.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: I will put my life in danger and refer the success to God, seeing it is for his glory and the deliverance of his Church.
